Pakistan Minister Avoids Terrorism, Indus Treaty Questions

Pakistan's Minister for Water Resources, Syed Khursheed Shah, avoided questions regarding terrorism and the Indus Waters Treaty during a press conference in New Delhi. When asked about terrorism, Shah stated, "We are not here to talk about terrorism." Regarding the Indus Waters Treaty, he remarked, "Let's have an easy conversation first," and when pressed further, said, "I was not invited to ask questions."
